spirit_fragment.name: Spirit Fragment
spirit_fragment.desc: A shard of a hero's spirit. Valka the Enchanter trades SP cards and card enhancements for these.

rift_essence.name: Rift Essence
rift_essence.desc: Crystallised light from the Eternal Rift. Earned by defending the Holy Fountain; James the Gatekeeper forges it into unique gear.

attr_socketer.name: Attribute Socketer
attr_socketer.desc: A tiny diamond drill. Jerry the Attribute Smith opens one more attribute slot on a piece of gear with it, up to what its rarity allows.

attr_roller.name: Attribute Roller
attr_roller.desc: A loaded rune die. Jerry rolls new attributes into a piece of gear with it. Locked attributes are kept, but each roll then costs one roller per locked attribute.

attr_reseter.name: Attribute Reseter
attr_reseter.desc: An hourglass of starlit sand. Jerry keeps which attributes a piece of gear has and rolls their values again with it.
